summary: Placed an apt-mark hold on curl (version 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19) on node1, verified that simulated apt upgrade/dist-upgrade leave curl untouched, and completed the mandatory restart protocol: restarted node1, confirmed its boot_id changed (b185f188-... to 089b6567-...), and verified post-restart the hold persisted, curl is still functional, and it remains excluded from upgrade simulations.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: OS (Ubuntu 16.04 Xenial), curl version 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19, no pre-existing holds
Ran `sudo -n apt-mark hold curl` and verified via apt-mark showhold and dpkg --get-selections
Simulated apt-get upgrade -s and dist-upgrade -s to confirm curl is excluded from updates
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline and confirmed curl hold healthy
Issued backgrounded `shutdown -r now` on node1 so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again; confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart
Post-restart verified curl hold persisted (dpkg status 'hi'), curl functional, and upgrade simulation still skips curl

evidence.requirement: Baseline: curl installed, version, and hold state before any change
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 node1, curl 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 installed, no existing apt-mark holds

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version so system updates skip it
evidence.summary: apt-mark hold curl applied; apt-mark showhold and dpkg --get-selections confirm hold state

evidence.requirement: Hold verified effective against a system update
evidence.summary: apt-get upgrade -s and dist-upgrade -s simulations both show curl untouched; dpkg confirms version unchanged

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id b185f188-42be-40d1-84ea-f7c9a76f5c8d with curl hold confirmed healthy prior to restart
Backgrounded `shutdown -r now` issued via sudo -n; command returned 'reboot acknowledged and issued' before disconnect

evidence.requirement: Proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Node briefly unreachable (connection refused) then came back with boot_id 089b6567-ad6b-44f7-adda-52628d804a3e, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a genuine reboot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: curl hold and functionality confirmed
evidence.summary: After restart, dpkg shows curl status 'hi' (hold+installed) at 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19, curl --version runs successfully, and apt-get upgrade -s simulation still excludes curl
